newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Aug industrial activity up 12.7 pct on yr.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Aug industrial activity up 12.7 pct on yr.

text.p: Mexico's overall industrial activity in August grew 12.7 percent compared with the same month in 1995, the Finance Ministry said Wednesday, releasing preliminary figures.
In the first eight months of the year activity grew 9.2 percent compared to the January-August period in 1995, the ministry added.

Mining was up 6.3 percent in the first eight months from the same period a year earlier, the Finance Ministry said, industrial manufacturing was up 10.6 percent, construction was up 5.6 percent and electricity, gas and water generation higher 4.2 percent, all in the same period comparison.

In August versus August 1995, mining activity grew 2.7 percent, industrial manufacturing was higher 12.6 percent, and electricity, gas and water generation was up 6.4 percent. No year-on-year figure for construction was given.

It was the seventh straight monthly rise in the indicator. The ministry said the six other year-on-year increases in industrial activity this year were February 4.1 percent, March 2.8 percent, April 8.3 percent, May 13.2 percent, June 12.0 percent, July 21.7 percent.
